name: v0.3.29 — Connections discoverable on mobile (Profile tile + long-press menu)
releaseNotes:
• Connections is now reachable on mobile from two places:
  → Profile screen: dedicated green tile in the quick-actions grid
  → Long-press the ⋮ Menu tab in the bottom nav → 'Connections' entry in the popover
• Route was already wired but had no entry point until now.
